channel.description: The channel slug, for example clock-out-early. It must match the Inbox folder you dropped into.

episode_id.description: The one episode id, <slug>-<year>-<SSEE>, SS the season and EE the episode, for example clock-out-early-2026-0101 (season 1, episode 1). The video file name must contain it.

description.description: The YouTube description and the Instagram and TikTok caption.

tags.description: Up to 30. Sent as YouTube tags and added as hashtags where the caption lacks them.

thumbnail_path.description: JPG or PNG next to the video, under 2 MB. Used as the YouTube thumbnail on long videos.

video_file.description: The video file name. It must equal the video file you dropped.

post_type.description: episode (the default when missing) is a full video. clip is a vertical clip, 9:16 and 5 to 90 seconds, with its own schedule.

channel_link.description: Clips only. On by default. Adds the show's YouTube channel link to the end of the clip description on every platform, after the "Full episode on YouTube" line. Send false to leave it off.

source_episode_id.description: For a clip: the episode it was cut from. Once that episode is live on YouTube, the clip description gets "Full episode on YouTube" and the link.

platforms.description: Required for an episode. A clip may leave it out and then goes to every platform the show has switched on for clips.

preferred_slot.description: Accepted and ignored. The schedule is set in ELO. A bot never sets, requests or promises a posting time.

approval.description: Josh approves outside ELO before the drop. A sidecar without it is rejected.

qc.description: The quality check result. Needed when "Require QC pass" is on in Settings.

beth_signoff.description: B.E.T.H. sign-off. Needed when "Require QC pass" is on in Settings.

render.description: Stored in the drop log only.

topic.description: A short topic tag such as browser or finance_debt. ELO warns when the same topic is scheduled back to back on a channel.

pinned_comment.description: A first comment (a question, a link). ELO posts it on YouTube when the video goes live and reminds the owner to pin it. Instagram, Facebook and TikTok comments are pasted by hand.

community_poll.description: A companion poll for the YouTube Community tab. ELO reminds the owner to post it 30 minutes after the video goes live (YouTube has no way for apps to post it).

thumbnail_variants.description: Up to 3 thumbnail images next to the video, best first. Only when "Swap in the next thumbnail" is on: if the click rate is under the owner's line after 24 hours, ELO puts on the second one.

search_phrases.description: Search phrases people type (from autocomplete). Added to the YouTube tags. If missing, ELO asks autocomplete itself.

description: The .json file that goes next to a finished video in a channel Inbox.
